Tie, with the tie breaker going to Codex.\\n     * With the release of GPT 5.5 and Opus 4.7 things have change.\\n     * -With GPT 5.5, on the highest thinking level, I get about 2 days of actually sitting at the computer and trying stuff out. ============================================================================\\n// pickGreedyStep — direction picker with the priority chain\\n//\\n//   FORCED ESCAPE.
